If the rate constant of the reaction is 5 $\times 10^{-4} s^{-1}$, assuming ideal gas behaviour, the value of Y is ...............
questions.explanation:
At constant V, T

At initial t = 0 and final t = y $\times 10^{3}$ sec

 \matrix{ {2{N_2}{O_5}(g)\buildrel \Delta  \over \longrightarrow } & {2{N_2}{O_4}(g) + } & {{O_2}(g)}  \cr 1 & 0 & 0  \cr {1 - 2p} & {2p} & p  \cr

}

1.4 = 1 + p

p = 0.45 atm

$k = {{2.303} \over t}\log {{{p_i}} \over {{p_i} - 2p}} p_{i}$ = 1 atm (given)

questions.explanation:
$\mathop {\lim }\limits_{n \to \infty } $\left[ {{{1 + $\root$ 3 $\of$ 2  + $\root$ 3 $\of$ 3  + ...$\root$ 3 $\of$ n } $\over$ {{$n^{7/3}$}\left( {{1 $\over$ {{{(an + 1)}^2}}} + {1 $\over$ {{{(an + 2)}^2}}} + ... + {1 $\over$ {{{(an + n)}^2}}}} \right)$}}} \right]$, $a \in R,\,|a|\, > 1 = \mathop {\lim }\limits_{n \to \infty } {{\sum\limits_{r = 1}^n {({r^{1/3}})} } \over {{n^{7/3}}\sum\limits_{r = 1}^n {{1 \over {{{(an + r)}^2}}}} }} = \mathop {\lim }\limits_{n \to \infty } {{\sum\limits_{r = 1}^n {{{$\left( {$\frac{r}{n}$} \right)$}^{1/3}}\frac{1}{n}} } \over {\sum\limits_{r = 1}^n {{1 \over {{{(a + \frac{r}{n})}^2}}}\frac{1}{n}} }} = {{\int\limits_0^1 {{x^{1/3}}dx} } \over {\int\limits_0^1 {{{dx} \over {{{(a + x)}^2}}}} }} = 54$, (given)

$\Rightarrow {{\frac{3}{4}[{x^{4/3}}]_0^1} \over {$\left[ { - {1 $\over$ {x + a}}} \right]$_0^1}} = 54 \Rightarrow {{\frac{3}{4}} \over { - {1 \over {a + 1}} + \frac{1}{a}}} = 54 \Rightarrow {3 \over {4 \times 54}} = {1 \over {a(a + 1)}} \Rightarrow {a^2} + a = 72 \Rightarrow {a^2} + 9a - 8a - 72 = 0 \Rightarrow a(a + 9) - 8(a + 9) = 0 \Rightarrow (a - 8)(a + 9) = 0 \Rightarrow a = 8$ or $- 9$

Hence, options (c) and (d) are correct.
